article: GIFアニメ画面録画ツール
findings: Removed duplicate 2026-09-24 metadata from all editions, retained the original 2024-02-08 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-23.
Fixed the Japanese typo and normalized the five ordered steps, including duplicate step numbers in several locales.

Clarified from the project README/source that this Windows tool outputs GIF animations and does not record audio; added guidance to check for private information before recording and review the GIF before sharing.
Confirmed the Releases page links GIFScreenRecorder.exe and the repository publishes source under MIT; localized compatibility/source notes and aligned all reference links.
No release binary was executed, scanned, or matched cryptographically to source; no malware or binary-integrity claim is made.
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Compared meaning, terminology, steps, output behavior, release/repository/license links, and source-backed product descriptions against the project README, C++ recording code, Windows project configuration, and current public release metadata.
